column1: # Hand corrections of Snowflake's Syntax blocks, applied by
# snowflake/parser/cmd/docsgrammar before it converts a page: the docs are
# prose, and some blocks do not read as notation as written. Each row is the
# page, the text as the page writes it (every occurrence is replaced), what
# the grammar reads instead, and why. \n and \t stand for a newline and a tab.
# The converter fails on a row whose text the page no longer holds.
